text: payments-api latency spiked right after the 2.3.1 deploy, but traces show the ledger-db connection pool exhausted on every request since 13:50, before the deploy. Raised pool size to 200, latency recovered. INC-4120
checkout 500s started 2 min after we rolled out checkout v4.1.0, NullPointerException in the new PromoService code path, rolled back, errors gone. INC-4388
someone flipped feature flag fast_auth=true in the prod config of auth-service at 09:12, p99 jumped from 80ms to 2s, flipped back, fixed
orders-api pods OOMKilled during the traffic peak, HPA maxed out at 40 replicas, bumped max to 80 and the memory limit, stable now
does anyone know who owns the ledger-db terraform module? need to request a quota change next week
search-api timeouts again; the elasticsearch cluster shows red status, 2 data nodes lost disks. Infra replacing nodes. No deploys today. INC-4501
notifications are delayed because MailRelay is returning 503s for every send since 10:00; our queue and workers look healthy
TLS handshake failures between web-frontend and checkout after the load balancer certificate expired at midnight, renewed it
the inventory migration dropped the reserved_qty column default, so new rows have nulls and checkout shows wrong stock
we saw a burst of login attempts from one ASN against auth-service using leaked credentials, blocked the range and forced resets
web-frontend DNS lookups for checkout failing intermittently from one zone, resolvers there were overloaded, moved to the other resolver pool
ledger-db disk filled up at 03:00 because WAL archiving stopped, cleared space and restarted archiving
payments-api started returning 400s after we changed the currency rounding setting in its config from 2 to 0 decimals, reverted the setting
rolled out search-api 1.9.0 and the new query parser rejects quoted phrases, rolling back to 1.8.4
CardRail authorization API latency went from 200ms to 4s for all merchants, their status page confirms an incident, nothing wrong on our side
a bad batch file from the partner left duplicate order rows in orders-api, wrote a dedupe script and reconciled
